title: Fix `ImageIterator` to accept negative steps
body:
This MR is a follow-up of !3942.

The present `ImageIterator` cannot handle negative steps.
For the following `test.xyz`
```
1
Properties=species:S:1:pos:R:3 pbc="F F F"
H        0.00000000       0.00000000       0.00000000
```
the following `test.py` shows `ValueError: Stop argument for islice() must be None or an integer: 0 <= x <= sys.maxsize.`.
```python
from ase.io.extxyz import iread_xyz

with open("test.xyz") as fd:
    for atoms in iread_xyz(fd, index="::-1"):
        print(atoms)
```
While the error message says about `stop`, the issue is actualy for `step` given to `islice`.

As written in [the official document](https://docs.python.org/3/library/itertools.html#itertools.islice), `islice` does not support negative values for `start`, `stop`, and `step`.
For the former two arguments, we can convert them to the corresponding non-negative values with [the `slice.indices` method](https://docs.python.org/3/reference/datamodel.html#slice.indices) used [in `ImageIterator`](https://gitlab.com/ase/ase/-/blob/a210e8e47ddc00863788a639a69bff61c913225e/ase/io/utils.py#L590), but `step` remains negative and causes the error above.

The present MR solves the issue by using `index2range` instead of `islice`.
More concretely, now `ImageIterator` once makes a list of chunks and then makes an iterator using `index2range`, which can handle also negative steps.

Note that the list of chunks is still light-weight as it defers the construction of the `Atoms` object in the `build` method in each chunk.
For `iread_xyz`, we can further make it memory-efficient, so that it stores not a list of lines but just a position of the file to start, which is also implemented in this MR.

- 5a807039: `test_iread_xyz` has been extended to test the slice with negative steps.
- 3e5f71b7: Just a minor refactor of `index2range` (not directly relevant to the main focus of this MR)
- d4aecfd5: Core of this MR
- 7ea34b1e: revision of `iread_xyz` to make it memory-wise light-weight. Note that I have also removed a few `try...except` contexts for cleanness but am also OK to revert.

@askhl Could you again kindly have a look when you have time?

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body:
Functionality-wise, it is just an extension to accept negative steps of `index` in `ImageIterator`.
While there are a few other changes in internal procedures of `iread_xyz`, the real impact on users may be marginal, as this function may be not often used so far.
I am therefore going to merge and then would like to proceed !3959 and other related changes.
